scripts.restart: pkill -f 'turbo run dev' 2>/dev/null; lsof -tnP -iTCP:4318,5173,5174 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'tsx watch src/main' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; pnpm dev
scripts.restart:web: lsof -tnP -iTCP:5173,5174 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; pnpm dev:web
scripts.restart:server: lsof -tnP -iTCP:4318 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; pnpm dev:server
scripts.restart:worker: pkill -f 'tsx watch src/main' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; pnpm dev:worker
